# Lettie Marchant & Nell Harcourt

- [Lettie Marchant](../character/lettie-marchant.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — imaginary friend created from a reflection in a bookcase door · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Nell’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md), which excites her greatly despite Thirza's attempts to temper her emotions. After attending tea with another girl named [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) Bradley, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) joyfully reports back to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about her wonderful evening, Mrs. Wace's kindness, and news that a female teacher named Miss Agnes [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) has been hired for the local school.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII. Nell Is Invited Out to Tea
